note: HSBC Hong Kong: HSBC One has no Total Relationship Balance requirement and no below-balance fee for holders of a Hong Kong identity card, which a resident holds; a non-HKID customer opening from 1 January 2026 pays 100 dollars a month below a 10,000-dollar balance, not modelled.

sources.title: HSBC Hong Kong, Account opening
sources.said: Below Balance fee 4 HSBC One For HKID holders: Nil For non-HKID holder customers opening an account before 1 Jan 2026: Nil For non-HKID holder customers opening an account on or after 1 Jan 2026: HKD100 per month
